name: Ward L. Lambert Fieldhouse and Gymnasium
changes_since_round1: Changed the exterior roof preview to use a matte, neutral surface and saved the interior review lights disabled for the default exterior view. Diagnostic renders showed those interior softboxes caused the broad white roof patch; they are turned on only for the cutaway preview.
Added 758 small gray glass-block joint segments over existing glazing bays, using the observed block-like window facade as a visual cue; exact module spacing is estimated.
Improved the existing concrete-pier rhythm and made the procedural brick material use a running-bond pattern at a consistent object-coordinate scale.
Added a short stepped Stadium Avenue entrance approach at the existing threshold and corrected the stair rise so it climbs toward the doorway; rail dimensions remain schematic.
Rebuilt the spectator banks as eight tiers on each long side, split into four seating groups by three access aisles.
Added a portable high-jump mat, standards and crossbar as event equipment visible in Lambert meet photography; placement is schematic and movable.
Measured the lane-one centerline directly from paired inner/outer vertices of the saved track mesh: 199.9889567 m, consistent with the official 200 m facility description.

references.use: Official building identity, address/corner context, 1937 opening and six-lane, 200 m Rekortan track. No roof elevation or track drawing is published on this page.

direct_mesh_measurement.method: average paired inner/outer boundary vertices at each station to recover the lane-one centerline polygon, then sum all closed polygon edge lengths in local meters
